findings.finding: Q3 holdings markdown. GoldMining holds 21.5M Gold Royalty shares (US$70.0M at May 31, at fair value through OCI), 19.1M NevGold shares (C$57.8M) and 74% of consolidated U.S. GoldMining. GROY drifted down toward $2.97 by 2026-10-02 and USGO went from about $10.20 in May to about $8.13 in July. Q3 OCI and reported investment values will therefore show a markdown. None of it touches operating loss, and all of it is quoted daily.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 release (2026-07-14, Q2 OCI loss C$7.0M) moved 0.0% per the baseline. No confirmed earnings release has a measurable reaction on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. GROY, USGO and NevGold trade daily and GLDG trades close to the sum of those stakes. If the release still carried new information on this line, GLDG would have to have diverged from the holdings tape, and it has not.
findings.independence: GROY price: https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/AMEX/GROY (close $2.97, 2026-10-02). USGO price: https://robinhood.com/stocks/USGO (about $8.13 in July 2026). Both are different sources from the 6-K.

findings.finding: Parent liquidity and ATM dilution. At May 31 cash was C$21.4M, of which C$8.2M sat inside USGO and was ring-fenced from the parent. The H1 operating loss was C$15.2M. Q3 carried the São Jorge 8,000 m RC program, the 1,218 m Yarumalito program (completed per the Oct 6 6-K) and Whistler drilling. The Q3 MD&A will therefore disclose ATM sales at prices below the C$1.66 Q2 average, or a sale of GROY shares, to fund the parent.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 release disclosed H1 ATM sales of 4.77M shares for C$10.1M, and the stock moved 0.0% (baseline, 2026-07-14).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The ATM program (to US$50M or 2026-12-08) is public, and steady ATM supply is consistent with the stock's slide from about $1.08 on 2026-09-09 to $0.89. The quarter's exact share count and proceeds are not public until the MD&A. Per LESSONS rule 4, the money buys drilling after three PEAs, there is no going-concern flag, and working capital was C$82.1M including C$157M of listed investments. That makes this a small negative, not a distress signal.
